findings.current: After that, he’d wanted to become a source of pride to the Jin Family of Taiyuan—and a brother his younger sibling could be proud of.
findings.defect: Makes Mukyung the older brother in an ambition that concerns being a younger brother.
findings.rationale: 아우 means younger brother. His separate wish to be an older brother worthy of Taekyung follows in the next paragraph.
findings.replacement: After that, he’d wanted to become the pride of the Jin Family of Taiyuan—and a younger brother his elder brother could be proud of.
findings.source: 그 이후에는 태원진가의 긍지이자 자랑스러운 아우가 되고 싶었다.

findings.current: The lives he’d taken had been earned not to kill, but to protect.
findings.defect: Says the lives were earned and gives an incoherent purpose for taking them; the source describes the burden of killing he accumulated.
findings.rationale: 살업 is the killing he has committed; the contrast is between killing for its own sake and killing to protect.
findings.replacement: The blood on his hands had come from protecting others, not from a desire to kill.
findings.source: 누군가를 죽이기 위해서가 아니라, 지키기 위해 쌓아 올린 살업(殺業)이었으니.

findings.current: And I’d inherited Jin Mukyung’s wish: that their sacrifices wouldn’t be in vain.
findings.defect: Changes a wish to prevent further sacrifices into a wish to give existing sacrifices meaning.
findings.rationale: 더는 있어서는 안 된다 means such sacrifices must not happen anymore.
findings.replacement: And I’d taken Jin Mukyung’s wish to heart: there must be no more sacrifices like theirs.
findings.source: 그런 그들의 희생이 더는 있어서는 안 된다는 진무경의 염원도 확실하게 이어받았다.

findings.current: He faced a silver-haired, middle-aged man with an unfamiliar face, watching them from a dozen *zhang* away with a deeply guarded gaze.
findings.defect: Changes the man’s singular target of attention to both brothers.
findings.rationale: 자신을 응시하는 specifies that the man is staring at the younger brother who faces him, not at “them.”
findings.replacement: He faced an unfamiliar, graying middle-aged man who stood a dozen *zhang* away, staring straight at him with a somber gaze.
findings.source: 십여 장 밖에서 깊게 가라앉은 눈빛으로 자신을 응시하는, 낯선 얼굴을 한 반백의 중년인을 마주한 채.

findings.current:
Flames poured from his eyes. His voice, by contrast, was cold as ice.

“Did you beat up my older brother?”
findings.defect: Flattens Taekyung’s blunt, intimate spoken 형 to the formal-sounding “older brother.”
findings.rationale: The binding address rule retains hyung when spoken 형 is the topic; the question’s bluntness also matters here.
findings.replacement:
Flames poured from his eyes. His voice, by contrast, was cold as ice.

“Was it you who beat up my hyung?”

findings.current: “I asked you. Did you beat up my older brother?”
findings.defect: Repeats the loss of Taekyung’s intimate kinship term in his direct challenge.
findings.rationale: 우리 형 is again spoken by the younger brother; this repeats the same pointed question.
findings.replacement: “I asked you. Was it you who beat up my hyung?”

findings.current: “Why are you making such a fuss? You’re making the people watching worry.”
findings.defect: Drops Murong’s “headache,” which sets up the skull-cracking treatment joke, and turns the speaker’s conversational concern into concern from spectators.
findings.rationale: 골치가 아프다 echoes Murong’s complaint and leads into 골을 깨부수는; 보는 사람 is a colloquial way for Taekyung to refer to himself here.
findings.replacement: “Why the headache? You’re making me worry.”
findings.source: “왜 골치가 아프고 그러냐. 보는 사람 걱정 되게.”

findings.defect: Retains square brackets inside a framed System panel, contrary to the specified panel format.
findings.rationale: The blockquote and System heading already identify the UI window; the binding Markdown rule removes brackets from System notices.

summary: Several scene facts and character cues need correction, especially Mukyung’s kinship, his final wish, and the target of Murong Baek’s gaze.
